💌 a letter from Adi
Reading your letter
made me smile 🥹
✨
— and tear up a little too, not gonna lie. Hahaha.
My dearest Maby,
Salamat kaayo sa tanan. For the patience, for the arrangements, for waiting up for me even when work keeps me longer than I'd like. I know it's not easy — 1.5 hours of travel, a demanding schedule, and a boyfriend who sometimes disappears into overtime. But the fact that you still show up, still make the effort, still wait — that means everything to me. I'll be honest — I get anxious too. When you want to see me and I can't be there right away, it eats at me. I hate the distance. I hate that sometimes work gets in the way of us. But I love that you understand my limits, and I love you even more for never making me feel guilty about them. And yes — I overthink sometimes. I know. Hahaha. But it only comes from loving you too much and wanting to protect what we have. So please be patient with me when those episodes come. All I need is you — your presence, your assurance, your "I love you." That's enough to calm everything. I always think about a future where we don't have to count travel hours or squeeze moments between deadlines. Where I can be close to you, always. That's what I'm working toward. That's what keeps me going. I love you so much, Maby. More than I probably say out loud. But I hope you feel it in every small thing I do.
💜
Always yours, Adi 💜
